selection.rule: per surveyed column: greedy cover of the union of the S06 files' survey classes, taking at each step the file that adds the most uncovered classes (ties: fewer bytes, then the smaller row id); then the spec's synthetic inputs in spec order. Rows are ordered by group (GROUPS order), column (spec order), survey rows in choice order, then synthetic rows.
